neighbours.label: possessive (and ' own') in the idiom 'of [their/our/his] (own) choosing / making / choice'
fire: Each student may write an essay on a topic of their own choosing.
The soldiers were sent to fight a war not of their choosing.
Guests can pick a dessert of their choice from the menu.
She built a career entirely of her own making.
You may donate the prize to a charity of your choice.
The painter lives in a dream world of his own creation.
Voters were stuck with a candidate not of their choosing.
Participants received a book of their choice as a reward.
quiet: Each student may write an essay on their own laptop at home.
The soldiers were sent to fight a war far from their homes.
Guests can pick a dessert from the menu at the end.
She built her own house entirely by hand.
You may donate your old clothes to a local charity.
The painter lives in his own studio above the gallery.
Voters chose their candidate after a long debate.
Participants received their books as a reward.

notes: Probe: 'of their own choosing' 0.96, 'of their choice' 0.62, 'of his own making' 0.56, 'not of our choosing' 0.49; 'their own cars', 'Their choice of', 'they had chosen' <0.03.
